plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-10 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) Economics (BA/BS) program page and its linked official degree map, 'Economics Degree Maps (2026-2027)', Economics (Campus) tab, last updated/reviewed August 3, 2026. Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. Collected as the B.S.: the catalog prints a single combined line, Total Credits, BA/BS Degree: 120, which the map matches exactly; the map expressly does not include the B.A.'s 16-credit foreign-language requirement. Every semester's courses sum to the map's printed semester total (16/15/15/15/15/15/15/14) and the plan to 120. Cross-check: the catalog's Economics Curriculum totals 44 credits (Foundation/Prerequisite Courses 11, Core Courses 18, Elective Courses 15), and every named curriculum course appears in the map: the Core's 'Complete One of the Following' choice (ECON 3000 Intermediate Microeconomics or ECON 3010 Managerial Economics) is the map's Year 3 Spring 'ECON Economics Core Elective' slot, recorded as a choice slot with both catalog options, and the 15 elective credits are the map's five ECON upper-division elective slots. The map's free-elective rows in Years 1-2 carry printed course recommendations (FIN 2870 in Year 1 Fall, ACCT 2010 in Year 1 Spring, BA 2010 in Year 2 Fall), recorded in the slots' notes; the rows themselves are printed as free electives and are recorded as such. Titles follow the map. GE and elective rows printed without course codes are recorded as choice slots with synthetic codes.
